info.description:
API of sbx: VM sandboxes for AI agents on Proxmox VE.

Errors always have the shape {error: {code, message, retryable, details, requestId}}.
Every response carries a Request-Id header.
info.title: sbx API

get.description: Interactive HTML reference (Scalar) rendered from `/v1/openapi.json`. Needs no authentication.

Quota of the request's team, its usage and the remainder, every allowed size of each template with `allowed` and the `reason` when not (template_disabled, quota_active_sandboxes, quota_ram), `canCreate`, and the rate limits. Node capacity is not promised: a create can still get 503 out_of_capacity. Any valid credential.

get.description: Who is calling: the person (null for a team API key), the team this request acts in, the person's teams with roles, operator rights, and the credential (kind, scopes, expiry). `sbx login` and `sbx whoami` call it to show the account and the default team.

Public facts about this deployment: API and dashboard URLs, the domain of published ports, the Keycloak issuer for `sbx login`, the SSH endpoint with its host keys, and CLI versions. Needs no authentication; clients call it first to configure themselves.
This OpenAPI 3.1 document, with the server URL and Keycloak issuer of this deployment. Needs no authentication. SDKs are generated from it.

post.description: Starts a new VM sandbox from a template (or a saved snapshot with `from`) and answers 202 at once with the sandbox in `creating` and its `create` operation. Wait for it with GET /v1/sandboxes/{sandbox}?waitFor=ready. All fields are optional. The team's environment (or the one named in `environment`) is applied first, the request's env, secrets and secret files on top. Send an Idempotency-Key to retry safely.

Answers 202 with the delete operation; on an already deleted sandbox 200 with `operation: null`. Repeating is safe.
